Class MenuHouseOptions

java.lang.Object
org.app.consoleMenu.houseMenu.MenuHouseOptions
public class MenuHouseOptions extends Object
The MenuHouseOptions class handles all operations related to house management. It interacts with the HouseService to retrieve, add, and query house data.

This class provides methods that are triggered by the console menu options to display all houses, add a new house, or search for a house by its key.

Usage:

The class is called by the main menu, where each option corresponds to a specific method in this class. The Scanner object is used to gather input from the user for operations like adding or querying a house.

  • Method Details

    • listAllHouses

      public void listAllHouses()
      Lists all houses by calling the HouseService.getAllHouses() method. If houses are found, they are printed to the console; otherwise, a message indicating that no houses were found is displayed.

    • addNewHouse

      public void addNewHouse(Scanner scanner)
      Adds a new house to the system based on user input. The method prompts the user to enter details such as the house key, name, founder, and region. This information is then used to create a new House object, which is passed to the HouseService.insertHouse(House) method.
      Parameters:
      scanner - The Scanner object used to gather input from the user.

    • queryHouseByKey

      public void queryHouseByKey(Scanner scanner)
      Queries the system for a house based on the house key provided by the user. If a matching house is found, it is printed to the console; otherwise, a message indicating the house was not found is displayed.
      Parameters:
      scanner - The Scanner object used to gather input from the user.
